snp2.2:1.1: Āmagandhasutta. "Sāmāka-ḍiṅgulaka-cīnakāni pattapphalaṃ mūlapphalaṃ gavipphalaṃ dhammena laddhaṃ satam añhamānā na kāmakāmā alikaṃ bhaṇanti. || ||
snp2.2:2.1: Yad añhamāno sukataṃ suniṭṭhitaṃ parehi dinnaṃ payataṃ panītaṃ| sālīnam annaṃ paribhuñjamāno so bhuñjatī Kassapa āmagandhaṃ. || ||
snp2.2:3.1: ‘Na āmagandho mama kappatī' ti icc-eva tvaṃ bhāsasi brahmabandhu sālīnam annaṃ paribhuñjamāno sakuntamaṃsehi susaṃkhatehi, -- pucchāmi tam Kassapa etam atthaṃ: kathappakāro tava āmagandho". || ||
snp2.2:4.1: "Pāṇātipāto vadhachedabandhanaṃ theyyaṃ musāvādo nikatī vañcanāni ca ajjhenakujjaṃ paradārasevanā, esāmagandho, na hi maṃsabhojanaṃ. || ||
snp2.2:5.1: Ye idha dāmesu asaññatā janā rasesu giddhā asucīkamissitā natthikadiṭṭhi visamā durannayā, esāmagandho, na hi maṃsabhojanaṃ. || ||
snp2.2:6.1: Ye lūkhasā dāruṇā piṭṭhimaṃsikā mittadduno nikkaruṇatimānino adānasīlā na ca denti kassaci, -- esāmagandho --pe--. || || Kodho mado thambho
snp2.2:7.1: paccuṭṭhāpanā ca māyā usuyyā bhassasamussayo ca mānātimāno ca asabbhi santhavo, esāmagandho . . . || || Ye pāpasīlā iṇaghāta-sūcakā
snp2.2:8.1: vohārakūṭā idha pāṭirūpikā narādhamā ye 'dha karonti kibbisaṃ, -- esāmagandho . . . || || Ye idha pāṇesu asaññatā
snp2.2:9.1: janā paresam ādāya vihesam uyyutā dussīla-luddā pharusā anādarā, -- esāmagandho . . . || || Etesu giddhā viruddhātipātino
snp2.2:10.1: nicc' uyyutā, pecca tamaṃ vajanti ye, patanti sattā nirayaṃ avaṃsirā, -- esāmagandho . . . || || Na macchamaṃsaṃ nānāsakattaṃ
snp2.2:11.1: na naggiyaṃ muṇḍiyaṃ jaṭā jallaṃ kharājināni vā nāggihuttass' upasevanā va yā ye vā pi loke amarā bahū tapā mantāhutī yañña-m-utūpasevanā sodhenti maccaṃ avitiṇṇakaṃkhaṃ. || ||
snp2.2:12.1: Sotesu gutto vijitindriyo care dhamme ṭhito ajjavamaddave {rato}, saṅgātigo sabbadukkhappahīno na lippati diṭṭhasutesu dhīro". || ||
snp2.2:13.1: Icc-etam attham Bhagavā punappunaṃ akkhāsi, taṃ vedayi mantapāragū, citrāhi gāthāhi muni-ppakāsayi nirāmagandho asito durannayo. || ||
snp2.2:14.1: Sutvāna Buddhassa subhāsitam padaṃ nirāmagandhaṃ sabbadukkhappanūdanaṃ nīcamano vandi Tathāgatassa tatth' eva pabbajjam arocayitthā ti || || ĀMAGANDHASUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ.
